title: Get Brand Identity Response
description: Brand identity data from a brand agent. Core identity (house, names, description, logos) is always public. Authorized callers receive richer data (high-res assets, voice synthesis, tone guidelines, rights availability). Includes available_fields to signal what the caller could unlock by linking their account.

house.description: The house (corporate entity) this brand belongs to. Always returned regardless of authorization level.

names.description: Localized brand names with BCP 47 locale code keys (e.g., 'en_US', 'fr_CA'). Bare language codes ('en') are accepted as wildcards for backwards compatibility.

keller_type.description: Brand architecture type: master (primary brand of house), sub_brand (carries parent name), endorsed (independent identity backed by parent), independent (operates separately)

logos.description: Brand logos. Public callers get standard logos; authorized callers also receive high-res variants. Shape matches brand.json logo definition.

colors.description: Brand color palette. Each role accepts a single hex color or an array of hex colors. Shape matches brand.json colors definition.

fonts.description: Brand typography. Each key is a role name (e.g., 'primary', 'secondary') referenced by type_scale entries. Values are either a CSS font-family string or a structured object with family name and font files. Shape matches brand.json fonts definition.

visual_guidelines.description: Structured visual rules for generative creative systems (photography, graphic_style, colorways, type_scale, motion). Matches brand.json visual_guidelines definition. Authorized callers only.

voice.description: Brand personality described as comma-separated adjectives (e.g., 'enthusiastic, warm, competitive')

attributes.description: Personality traits that characterize the brand voice, used as prompt guidance

dos.description: Approved messaging approaches, content themes, and reference points

donts.description: Prohibited topics, competitor references, and phrasings to avoid

oneOf.description: Plain tagline string for backwards compatibility
Localized taglines with BCP 47 locale codes

tagline.description: Brand tagline or slogan. Accepts a plain string or a localized array matching the names pattern.

voice_synthesis.description: Voice synthesis configuration for AI-generated audio

assets.description: Available brand assets (images, audio, video). Authorized callers only. Shape matches brand.json asset definition.

rights.description: Rights availability summary. For detailed pricing, use get_rights.

collections.description: Experimental (brand.collection_links). Collections this person or brand is associated with, mirroring the brand.json brand-level collections links, so a buyer can go from a person's identity to their channels without fetching the static file. Public, like brand.json. Each link names the collection by publisher_domain and collection_id, which together form a product collections selector; full collection objects come from the selling agent's responses or the publisher's adagents.json. These are the brand's own claims: a collection's talent[].brand_ref link is confirmed when this list names the same {publisher_domain, collection_id} back.

publisher_domain.description: Publisher namespace that declares the collection in its adagents.json

role.description: This person's role on the collection

seller_agent_url.description: URL of the sales agent that sells inventory for this collection. A routing hint, not authorization evidence: which agent may sell the collection is answered only by the publisher's adagents.json.

available_fields.description: Fields available but not returned in this response due to authorization level. Tells the caller what they would gain by linking their account via sync_accounts. Values match the request fields enum.
